description: Permanent in-process contract for ./sandbox.sh reset after Phase 3D. Ordinary text remains Bash-compatible; stronger live/stale cleanup is recorded explicitly.

manifests.proxy-agent:
name: proxy-agent
runtime:
  mode: interactive
filesystem:
  state:
    - key: config
      target: /home/node/.config
    - key: cache
      target: /home/node/.cache
llm:
  broker: true
  protocol: anthropic
  provider: anthropic
  api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  direct_domain: api.anthropic.com
network:
  mode: proxy
  allow_domains: [statsig.com]
  verify_domain: statsig.com
manifests.stateless-agent:
name: stateless-agent
runtime:
  mode: interactive
network:
  mode: isolated
